notes.general_comments:
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 3, 5, 7, 11, and 19. These
questions were answered correctly by 80% or more of the candidates. They covered different parts of the
syllabus and were set to test different skills.
The questions for which the fewest candidates selected the correct answer were 6, 18, and 25. These
questions were answered correctly by 40% or fewer candidates. The rest of the questions gave results which
were well within the levels expected.
